channel.title: Dev Diary — Ibrahim Faruquee
channel.description: Development journal of Ibrahim Faruquee — field notes on full-stack builds, applied machine learning, real-time systems, and the interfaces in between.

item.title: WHY ONE INTERFACE FELT WRONG
item.description: FaceyBuk's shared parent/child UI technically worked — until splitting it by role turned a video call into a shared room. Same story, two intents.

item.title: 3D MARKERS FROM A FLAT SCREENSHOT
item.description: Gemini finds evidence in 2D. Dropping those detections back into world space without raycasting the whole scene to death is the entire job.

item.title: WHEN TO TRUST A SINGLE THRESHOLD
item.description: Heat Aware's simplest version — one number, one phone call — is the feature, not the bug. Here's where a bare threshold holds up, and where it quietly doesn't.
